entries.assessment_basis: Direct comparison of the current Article 10 and Article 13 EXTREQ records against the authoritative consolidated EUR-Lex text demonstrated material article-level semantic compression.
known_fidelity_gaps: Article 10 currently compresses multiple independently assessable data-governance, dataset-quality and bias-management propositions into one requirement record.

Other operator-facing article-level records require the same semantic-atomicity review before clause-level fidelity can be asserted.
entries.next_action: Re-extract the represented operator-facing scope at paragraph, point or independently assessable proposition level and obtain specialist legal assurance before fidelity can be marked assured.
